pkgmetadata.longdescription:
CodeDiff is a syntax-aware diff tool. Instead of aligning two files line by line, it parses both sides with tree-sitter and matches their syntax trees, so a change is reported as what it structurally is - an insertion, a deletion, an update, or a move - rather than as whichever lines happened to line up.
It runs as an interactive terminal UI, as a plain-text batch formatter, or as a JSON emitter for editor integrations, and it works as a git difftool backend and a Jujutsu (jj) diff formatter.
